correctness.rationale: On each fixed cyclic-order irreducible sector, ordered lifts give D(x^{i,+})/D(x)=c/a_i, including ring wraparound because product_i(c/a_i)=1. The exact off-diagonal and diagonal similarity Q_a=D Q_c D^-1−(sum a_i−kc)I follows. The cyclic Vandermonde determinant identity yields identical positive right and left homogeneous Perron eigenvectors h0 and λ_c=c(k−sin(kπ/n)/sin(π/n)). Conjugating gives right Dh0, left h0/D, survival asymptotics and a generator-level Doob-transform equality; stationary density is h0². AM–GM and Taylor expansion give sharp rate penalty and n^-2 weak-disorder crossover, with k fixed. Independently constructed finite killed generators on complete labeled cyclic sectors for (n,k)=(5,2),(6,3),(7,3),(7,4) and rates (.7,2,1.3,3.1) verify both left/right eigenidentities and entrywise similarity to ≤9.1e−13. These four finite cases corroborate but do not replace the determinant/gauge proof.
